records.question: Which countries in europe have at least 3 car manufacturers?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.CountryName FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CONTINENTS AS T2 ON T1.Continent  =  T2.ContId JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T1.CountryId  =  T3.Country WHERE T2.Continent  =  'europe' GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*)  >=  3
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.CountryName, COUNT(cm.Id) AS maker_count
FROM car_makers cm
JOIN countries c ON cm.Country = c.CountryId
JOIN continents co ON c.Continent = co.ContId
WHERE co.Continent = 'europe'
GROUP BY c.CountryName
HAVING COUNT(cm.Id) >= 3
ORDER BY maker_count DESC

records.question: What are the ids of the students who do not own cats as pets?

FROM Student S
